newsitem.title: USA: J. Baker May same-store sales fell 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: J. Baker May same-store sales fell 5 pct.

text.p: NOTE: Figures in millions except percentage.
Month is four weeks ended May 31.
Full company name is J. Baker Inc

The company said the decrease is primarily a result of the divestitures of Shoe Corporation of America (SCOA) and Parade of Shoes divisions in March 1997 as well as the downsizing of the company's Licensed Discount footwear division. Exclusive of SCOA and Parade of Shoes, the company's sales in the Casual Male, Work n Gear and Licensed Discount divisions in the same period last year totaled $49 million.
